title: Canopticon public-site records (Black Box, 11 Oct 2026)
description: Records the redesigned public site renders. Extends canopticon-record.schema.json (Piece, Quote, Derivation, Topic…), which still governs the read. Every file in content/ validates against one of these.

Topic.description: One of the Library topics; slug rule: lowercase, & → and, non-alphanumerics → -.

LibraryItem.description: content/library.json — one row per listed thing. The Library, Front, Topic pages, Search and the feeds all read this list.

stat.description: Right-hand meta line, e.g. '48 quotes · 9 min' or '41 figures · 59 sources'. Computed, never typed.

shelf.description: 'investigation' rows appear on /investigations, not in Topic hubs.

Article.description: content/articles/<slug>.md front matter. Body is Markdown; every verbatim quotation is <q doc="<doc id>" section="<section label>">exact text</q>; [label](doc:<id>) is a plain link to a document. Text outside <q> is the author's own (render with the dotted 'no receipt' underline).

why.description: 'Why I asked' — the author's reason, shown above the thesis. Empty for two articles that open with it in the body.

Paper.description: content/papers/<slug>.md — the author's own work; body is the uploaded Markdown with its reference list. Highlighted text is still a verbatim quote tied to a reference; no dotted underlines.

series.description: e.g. 'McLuhan and the senses'; items show 'Part of' with links to the others.

Concept.description: content/terms.json — coined or adopted terms (route /concepts/<id>). Reaches the public only after the prior-art check (TERMS.md). Three concepts also have hand-built long pages (Concept, Concept CPAI, Concept Overhearer).

OpenProblem.description: content/problems.json — a gap a document states (route /open/<id>). Links to the document that stated it and, where one exists, the article or paper that leans on it.

Question.description: content/questions.json — a question a document asks, linked to the passage (Topic page 'Questions').

KeyFigure.description: content/key-figures.json — a figure stated in a document (Topic page 'Key figures', Search).

title.description: the sentence carrying the figure, verbatim

TopicTimelineWork.description: content/topic-timeline.json — dated works the topic's research cites; shown only for topics with ≥4.

ImportItem.description: content/import-list.json — every research document, where its text is, and whether it is already on the live site.

AdminCard.description: /desk 'Waiting for you' — one card per decision.
